question: In which year were the Fundamental Duties added to the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1976**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution in 1976 through the **42nd Amendment Act**.
 
• This concept of Fundamental Duties was inspired by the **Constitution of the Soviet Union**.
